Use "smooth" for clearance that changes only next to geom_gene() and geom_feature() polygons, or "none" for fixed spacing 0.035. Text and leader lines are ignored. current_documentation: Leader routing style. The default `"radial"` measures actual text boxes, separates site anchors from final radial label positions, and routes either a direct connector or an independent radial stub plus fan segment. All enzyme-facing text edges follow one close circular contour in genomic order. Dense lateral clusters use evenly spaced contour fans, while sparse clusters retain their natural angular positions. The former `"trunk"` alias was removed in v0.16.1; use `"radial"`. `"straight"` connects the tick tip directly to the final label edge, without detours around the sequence or other leaders. `"elbow"` uses one bend, starting with a local-normal departure where possible. Label positions and grouping are shared by all routing styles.
